entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Between 1450 and 1750, an estimated 40,000–60,000 people were executed for witchcraft — 80% women. The Malleus Maleficarum (1487) provided a handbook. Salem (1692) is famous, but the real epicenter was Europe. Accusations often targeted healers, widows, and social outsiders.
